resources.string: Show Samsung deep-sleeping apps to Play Store and Galaxy Store while preserving deep sleep.
Only the two stores see Samsung auto-disabled apps as enabled. Background restrictions and your deep sleep list stay in place. Manually disabled apps keep their original state.
Enable SleepStore in Vector / LSPosed, select Google Play Store and Galaxy Store, then restart both stores. No Runner step is needed. Android 16 with Samsung’s auto-disable API is required.
This indicator checks this app only. Store injection and update detection must be verified separately.
